NAMESPACE is singular in the actual declaration (the DTD comment uses a plural typo); the harness uses the correct attribute.

Namespace processing is enabled for1992 selected rows and disabled for the9 NAMESPACE=no rows as catalog instructions require. All selected IDs are unique.

Catalog documentation explicitly requires a nonvalidating parser to accept both valid and invalid cases. not-wf must reject when referenced external entities are read. error cases have no required acceptance outcome and must remain observations, excluded from mandatory conformance totals.

One xml:base typo in the original top-level catalog affects9 misc descriptors. The harness retains original and corrected paths without editing suite files. Catalog parent xml:base stack correctly remains in scope across parsed catalog entity inclusion.

Runtime resolver permits local file URLs only, canonicalizes paths, and confines them to the suite root; each loaded file records SHA256. ctypes parser handles/context use pointer-sized types; XML_Parse receives Python bytes with explicit length, preserving embeddedNUL. XML_ParserCreateNS receives one ASCII separator byte. Callback object remains strongly referenced by the parse scope, and nested children are freed exactly once after their feeds finish; parent survives every child callback.

Handler catches ordinary Python exceptions, records them and returns external failure. Root file-read errors would abort the worker instead of fabricating a row; both workers exited0 with6003 observations. Suspension is not requested by any installed callback.

Per-file2MiB check occurs after read; it is a trusted pinned-suite harness, not an untrusted file-size sandbox. External depth32/request1024 bounds and reported OS budgets must remain explicit limits. Current results show no resolver-budget failures.
